initial_assertion.statement: For each fixed q>=3 and reduced residue a, the published theta estimate implies infinitely many positive primes in that class, avoiding every finite set.

initial_assertion.limit_order: Fix q,a first; take x beyond its source threshold and log(x)>2c_theta(q)phi(q); deduce unbounded theta.
